data.volcano-scheduler.conf:
actions: "enqueue, allocate, worker-type-preempt, backfill"
tiers:
- plugins:
  - name: worker-type-preemption
    arguments:
      victimQueue: wt-shared
      pipelineBudgets: false
  - name: priority
  - name: gang
    enablePreemptable: false
  - name: conformance
- plugins:
  - name: predicates
  - name: proportion

configurations:
- name: worker-type-preempt
  arguments:
    recoveryNamespace: worker-type-prototype
    recoveryName: worker-type-test-recovery
    evictionTimeoutSeconds: 2
    pipelineBudgets: false
